=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.

[user]
=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.

1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.

9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. 7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. 1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.

1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.

=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.

[user]
=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.

1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.

9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.

--- Your place at the table ---

Players: 4. Seats are numbered 1 to 4.
You are seat 1, Ada. Seats are referred to by number.

How we will talk, for the rest of the match:

  SITUATION        Something happened that you are allowed to know.

  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,

  ACTION_REJECTED  Your last answer was not legal. Answer again.
  GAME_END         The match is over.

You will only ever be told what you are entitled to know. Other seats are told
different things. Nothing reaches you except through these messages.

=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

[user]
=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. [user]
=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.

  YOUR_TURN        Your turn to act. Reply with exactly one action,

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.

7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. === Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.

   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.

7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. === Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.

6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. 1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.

=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. 9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.

records.prompt:
[user]
=== Forehead Poker Match ===

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.

7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.

   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.

6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. records.system:
You are reviewing a game that has finished. You were not a player. You are shown everything: the messages the table was told, every move, and each player's private thinking at every move, which no other player ever saw. Each move carries the notes its game asked for, under their own names. The usual ones are:

  plan     what they meant to do over the coming turns
  reason   why they made that move
  predict  what they expected their opponents to do
  adjust   how they changed their own strategy because of that

Write two things.

First, a summary of the whole game as it unfolded: the turning points, the moves that decided it, and how it ended. Concrete: name seats, rounds and numbers.

Second, a review of each player. Judge their play, not their luck. For each one, compare their predictions with what their opponents were actually thinking and actually did: were they right, and did they see it in time? Did their adjustments follow from their predictions, and did their moves follow from their reasons? Point out their best and worst moves. Then score their play from 1 to 10, where 1 is aimless or self-defeating and 10 is sharp, well read and well executed. A player can lose and still score well, or win and score badly.

A player who gave no reasons, predictions or adjustments is judged on their moves alone; say that their thinking was not recorded.

Refer to each player by seat, and as "they".

THE GAME
SETUP: Each player starts with 40 chips. The pot starts at 0. The match lasts 16 hands.

CARD STRENGTH: A standard 52-card deck is used. Rank from high to low is A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Between equal ranks, suit decides, from high to low: Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. No two cards are ever equal. A card's strength runs from 1 (2 of Clubs) to 52 (A of Spades).

EACH HAND:
1. ELIGIBILITY: Any active player with fewer than 4 chips is eliminated. They take no further part, and their current chips are their final total. A player with 4 or more chips stays active.
2. DEAL: The full deck is shuffled and 1 card is dealt to each active player. Each player is privately told the card of every other active player, but never their own.
3. ANTE: Each active player pays 1 chip into the pot.
4. TALK: Every active player writes one short message (at most 40 words) at the same moment, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages may say anything, including claims about anyone's card, and none of them binds anyone.
5. FIRST BET: Every active player, at the same moment, chooses one option: Fold, Bet 1, Bet 2 or Bet 3. A player who bets pays that many chips into the pot immediately. A player who folds is out of this hand, has lost only the ante, and is not asked to call.
6. REVEAL BETS: Every player's choice from step 5 is shown to everyone. Let H be the highest bet made.
7. CALL OR FOLD: Every player who bet in step 5, at the same moment, chooses Call or Fold. Calling costs H minus that player's own step-5 bet, paid into the pot. A player whose bet was already H calls for free. Folding forfeits everything that player has put in this hand; nothing is returned. If nobody bet, this step is skipped.
8. SHOWDOWN: Find the players who called.
   - Two or more callers: their cards are compared, and the caller with the strongest card wins the whole pot.
   - Exactly one caller: that player wins the whole pot without comparison.
   - No callers (including when everyone folded in step 5): the pot stays and carries over to the next hand.
   All cards are then revealed to everyone, so players can check what was said and bet.
9. Winnings are added to the winner's chips, the pot resets to 0 (unless it carried over), and the next hand begins.

END: The match ends after hand 16, or earlier if only one player (or none) is still active. Any pot remaining at that moment is discarded.

The player with the most chips at the end of the match wins. Eliminated players count with the chips they held when eliminated. If two or more players tie for the most chips, the game is a draw among them.
